about:
Founded in 1913 by Albert Wendling in Charleston, West Virginia, A.F. Wendling's Foodservice began as a fresh meat delivery service. The company remains family-owned and operated, now headquartered in Buckhannon, West Virginia.

Today it operates as West Virginia's largest independent broadline foodservice distributor, supplying more than 9,000 products — fresh meats, seafood, refrigerated and frozen items, and non-food supplies — across West Virginia, Virginia, western Pennsylvania, and surrounding states. The distributor added over 800 square feet of freezer capacity to support expanded service territories and fulfills orders through a direct-delivery model with dedicated customer-service representatives.

The company serves restaurants, institutional kitchens, and other foodservice operators throughout the Mid-Atlantic region. As a member of UniPro Foodservice, it provides access to dozens of exclusive brand lines tailored to diverse menu requirements.

The business was founded to provide reliable fresh meat delivery to local customers and continues to emphasize personalized, customer-focused service — one customer and delivery at a time.
